about: Menelik takes his father's blessing and sets out for Ethiopia; Zion is secretly loaded onto a cart, the city discovers its loss in grief, and Solomon, weeping, recalls the prophecies that law and wisdom would pass to other peoples.

sentences.i: After this the king of Ethiopia rose to go to his own country. He went in to his father to pray for him (?), and said to him, 'Bless me, father,' and bowed before him.
sentences.n: ተንሥአ 'arose' (perfect 3rd masc. sing.); ንጉሠ is the construct form of ንጉሥ 'king' — 'king-of Ethiopia' — so the king is Menelik, here Ethiopia's king. ከመ ይሖር 'that he might go' (ከመ + subjunctive ይሖር). ወቦአ 'and he entered'; ኀበ 'to'. ይጸሊ ሎቱ — ጸለየ 'pray'; with ሎቱ ('to/for him') the sense may be 'pray for him' or 'pray with/before him' (?). ወይቤሎ = ወ + ይቤ 'he said' + ሎ 'to him'; ባርከኒ imperative + 'me'.

sentences.l: And-he-raised-him and-blessed-him and-took-hold-of-him (by) his-head, and-said:
sentences.i: His father raised him up, blessed him, and took hold of his head (?), and said:
sentences.n: Each verb carries 'him' as the suffix -ኦ, fused with the verb's last vowel (አንሥኦ, ባረኮ, አኀዞ). አኀዞ ርእሶ 'he took hold of him, his head' — 'took him by the head' or 'embraced his head' (?); ርእስ 'head' is also the Geʿez word for 'self', so a reflexive sense is possible. The subject of all three verbs is the father, who raises Menelik after he bows. ፤ ends the unit before the blessing begins.

sentences.i: Blessed is God, my God, who blessed my father David and who blessed our father Abraham. May he be with you at all times and bless your seed, as he blessed Jacob and multiplied his seed like the stars of heaven and the sand of the sea;
sentences.n: ዘባረኮ ለአቡየ 'who blessed my father' — the relative ዘ- plus a verb with a pronoun 'him' that repeats the object (ለ- marks the object). የሀሉ and ይባርክ are jussives ('may he be', 'may he bless'). ዘርእከ 'your seed' (ዘርእ + ከ). Allusions: Genesis 22:17 (seed like the stars and the sand) and the blessing of Jacob (Genesis 28). The speaker is Solomon, so 'my father David'.

sentences.l: And-as blessed-him Abraham to-Isaac my-father, so may-be your-blessing from-dew-of heaven and-from-breadth-of-it (?) of-earth, and-be-subject to-you all livestock and-birds-of heaven and-beasts-of wilderness and-fish-of sea;
sentences.i: And as Abraham blessed my father Isaac, so may your blessing be from the dew of heaven and from the breadth of the earth (?), and may all livestock, the birds of heaven, the beasts of the wilderness, and the fish of the sea be subject to you;
sentences.n: በከመ … ከማሁ 'as … so'. The nouns in chains are construct: ጠለ ሰማይ 'dew-of heaven' (cf. Genesis 27:28, Isaac's blessing of Jacob). እምስፍሓ ለምድር 'from the breadth of the earth' — ስፍሕ 'width', with a pronoun -ሓ anticipating ለምድር; 'breadth' is my reading, where Genesis 27:28 has 'fatness' (?). ይትአዘዝ ለከ 'may it obey/be subject to you' (ተ-stem of አዘዘ 'command'), with ኵሉ እንስሳ 'all livestock' as the subject. The three nouns አዕዋፈ, አራዊተ, ዓሣተ are in the accusative, so they might instead be objects of an unstated verb; I read them as further subjects (?).

(መስተቀይም); be pure and-not filthy; be righteous and-not sinner; be merciful and-not wrongdoer; be bright and-not captor (?) (ፀዋግ); be patient and-not wrathful (?) (ምዑዕ);
sentences.i: Be full, and not wanting (?); be perfect, and not deficient; be gentle, and not a dweller (?); be healthy, and not sick; be good, and not one who opposes (?); be pure, and not filthy; be righteous, and not a sinner; be merciful, and not unjust; be bright, and not a captor (?); be patient, and not wrathful (?);
sentences.n: A run of paired commands: ኩን 'be!' (imperative of ኮነ) + an adjective in the accusative (ምሉአ, ፍጹመ …), then ወአኮ 'and not' + its opposite. Clear pairs: ፍጹም/ሕጹጽ 'perfect/deficient', ጥዑይ/ሕሙም 'healthy/sick', ንጹሕ/ርሱሕ 'pure/filthy', ጻድቅ/ኃጥእ 'righteous/sinner', መሓሪ/ዐማፂ 'merciful/wrongdoer'. Uncertain opposites: ንቱግ, ነቢር, መስተቀይም, ፀዋግ, ምዑዕ — the glosses given are guesses from the roots and are marked (?). ነቢረ may come from ነበረ 'sit, dwell' (the sense as the opposite of 'gentle' is unclear), and ምዑዕ I connect, as a guess, with a root for anger or heat (?).

sentences.l: And-may-she-be for-you guide my-lady Zion, holy, heavenly, ark-of the-law of-God, at-all time, to-where you-have-thought in-your-heart and-looked-toward (?) with-your-fingers: that-which-far and-that-which-near for-you; to-where that-which-low and-that-which-high for-you; to-where that-which-strong and-that-which-weak for-you; to-where that-which-outside and-that-which-within for-you; to-where that-which-house and-that-which-wilderness for-you; to-where that-which-appears and-that-which-does-not-appear for-you; to-where that-which-እቱት (?) and-clinging for-you; to-where that-which-hidden and-revealed for-you; to-where that-which-closed and-manifest for-you — may-she-be-for-you guide, our-lady Zion, holy, heavenly, ark-of the-law of-God, pure.
sentences.i: May Zion, my lady — holy, heavenly, the Ark of the Law of God — be a guide to you at all times, wherever you have thought in your heart and pointed (?) with your fingers: whether far or near to you; wherever low or high; wherever strong or weak; outside or within; house or wilderness; visible or unseen; loose (?) or clinging; hidden or revealed; closed or open to view. May she be your guide, our lady Zion, holy, heavenly, the Ark of the Law of God, the pure one.
sentences.n: One long sentence with no ፤ to cut at, kept whole. The frame: ወትኩን ለከ መርሐ 'may she be a guide for you' (መርሐ accusative predicate), then ኀበ 'to where' + a pair of ዘ- phrases ('that which is …') repeated: nine pairs in all, the first (ዘርሑቅ ወዘቅሩብ) without a second ኀበ, the other eight each introduced by ኀበ, and every pair closing with ለከ 'for you'. Note ወዘልዑልለከ is written as one word (ወዘልዑል + ለከ). ዘእቱት is unclear (?); 'loose' is a guess from the contrast with 'clinging'. አንጸረ I know as 'look toward, regard'; 'pointed' is my reading of 'with your fingers' (?). The sentence then repeats the opening formula, ending with the adjective ንጽሕት 'pure' (feminine, agreeing with ጽዮን). ታቦተ ሕጉ ለእግዚኣብሔር 'ark-of the-law of-God': Zion is identified with the Ark, the book's central idea.

sentences.l: And-although not-they-knew openly that had-risen Zion from-among-them, in-their-hearts indeed not they-erred; and-they-wept bitterly, as when killed God the-firstborn-of-them of-Egypt, so they-were: and-there-was-not a-house where there-was-not wailing from men to livestock — dogs even howled, and-donkeys even brayed — and-all of-them together shed their-tears, those-who remained there;
sentences.i: Even though they did not know openly that Zion had risen up from among them, in their hearts they were not mistaken. They wept bitterly, as when God killed the firstborn of Egypt, so it was: there was no house without wailing, from people to livestock. Even the dogs howled and the donkeys brayed, and all together, those who remained there, let their tears flow;
sentences.n: ወሶበኒ 'and even when / although'; ገሃደ 'openly'; -ሰ in በልቦሙሰ is an emphatic enclitic ('in their hearts, indeed'). Allusion: the death of Egypt's firstborn and the cry that followed, Exodus 12:29–30. ወአልቦ ቤተ ኀበ አልቦ አውያተ 'there was no house where there was no wailing' (አልቦ 'there is not'). The -ኒ on ከለባትኒ and አእዱግኒ is 'even/also'. የአውይዉ and ይንህቁ are imperfects used for a vivid past. ያውሕዙ አንብዖሙ 'made their tears flow' (አ-stem).

sentences.i: As when an enemy's mighty emissaries (?) besiege a great city, attack it (?), plunder it (?), take it captive, and put it to the sword, so it was with the city of Zion, that is Jerusalem.
sentences.n: ከመ ዘ 'as when / like that which' … ከማሁ ኮነት 'so it was': the simile of a sacked city. መላእክተ ፀር 'messengers-of enemy' — literally 'the enemy's messengers' (the same word as 'angels'), here probably envoys or troops (?). The verbs are plural perfects with 'it' (feminine -ሃ, written -ዋ after -ት/-ው) as object; ዐገትዋ is ዐገቱ + -ሃ, the object ለዐባይ ሀገር doubled by the suffix: ዐገተ 'besieged', ሮድዋ 'attacked' (?), ማህረከ 'plundered' (?), ፄወወ 'took captive'. በአፈ ኀጺን 'by the mouth of iron' = by the edge of the sword. Here Zion means Jerusalem, whose heart, the Ark, has just been removed. ፨ ends the unit.

sentences.n: ደንገፀ 'was dismayed, startled'; -ኒ after ንጉሥ is 'too'. ብካይ 'weeping' and ጽራኀ 'cry' (construct before ሀገር). ሐወጸ 'he looked out / went to look' (?). እንተ is the feminine relative 'which', so 'from' is my guess at the sense (?). ታዕካ (taʿka) is left untranslated, as in ch. 25–26 and 43: apparently a part of the palace; ቀልዐ 'citadel' is a guess (?). ቤተ መንግሥት 'house-of kingdom' = the royal palace. እንዘ ትበኪ 'while she (the city) weeps'; ተትልዎሙ 'following them' (?).

sentences.i: Like a child whom his mother has left (?), she having fled from him, and he follows after her crying and weeping — so they were, crying out and weeping, putting ashes on their heads and letting tears run from their eyes.
sentences.n: ከመ ሕፃን ዘ … ከማሁ ኮኑ 'like a child who … so they were'. The text has a spaced ዘ ('whom'). ጥበ እሙ — I take ጥበ as 'breast' (?), so 'his mother's breast abandoned him' (?), i.e. a child forsaken by his mother; I have smoothed this in the translation. ይተሉ አሠረ እሙ 'he follows his mother's track' (አሠር 'track, trace'). ይወድዩ ሐመደ ዲበ ርእሶሙ 'they put ashes on their heads', the standard mourning gesture. ያስሕዙ, with አንብዐ 'tears', must mean 'make flow', like ያውሕዙ earlier in the chapter; I take it as a variant spelling of that verb (?).

sentences.i: And in another place he says, 'Ethiopia will hand over her hands to God, and he will receive her with honour; and the kings of the earth will praise God';
sentences.n: Echoes Psalm 68:31–32 (67:32 in the Septuagint numbering). The Geʿez verb is ትሜጥዎ 'she will hand over to him' (መጠወ + -ዎ), with እደዊሃ 'her hands' as the thing handed over; the sense is the same gesture of submission, but 'stretch out' is not in this word. The ሜ of ትሜጥዎ is not the regular vowel of መጠወ, so ሜጠ 'turn' ('she will turn her hands to him') may be the verb instead (?). ይትሜጠዋ — 'he will receive her' (ተ-stem, ተመጠወ). ይሴብሕዎ 'they will praise him'. ወበካልእኒ 'and in another (psalm)'.

glossary.ሰረገላ: ሰረገላ — chariot (noun) · also 'cart' for the vehicle that carries the Ark among the baggage (ውስተ ሰረገላ 'onto a cart')
glossary.ሰረገላት: ሰረገላ — chariots (plural ሰረገላት of ሰረገላ 'chariot') · 'carts' of the loaded train (ተጽዕኑ ኵሉ ሰረገላት 'all the carts were loaded')
glossary.ሰእለ: ሰአለ — he asked, begged (3ms perfect, s-ʾ-l; function in the clause unclear) (?)
glossary.ሴልየ: ሴልየ — unidentified; apparently an exclamation 'alas' or a noun + -የ '1cs my' (?)
glossary.ቀልዐ: ቀልዕ — citadel, tower (noun, in apposition to ታዕካ; sense inferred) (?)
glossary.ቀተለ: ቀተለ — he killed (3m sg perfect, q-t-l)
glossary.ቅድሜሁ: ቅድመ — before him (preposition ቅድመ in its form ቅድሜ- + -hu 'him')
glossary.ቊስቋሳት: ቊስቋስ — unidentified word, apparently a kind of ware (noun, plural; lemma assumed from the form) (?)
glossary.በሌሊት: ሌሊት — by night (በ- 'in' + noun, fem.; adverbial)
glossary.በልብከ: ልብ — in your heart (በ- + ልብ + -ከ '2ms your')
glossary.በልቦሙሰ: ልብ — in their hearts, indeed (በ- + noun + -ሙ '3mp their' + enclitic -ሰ)
glossary.በኅሱራት: ኅሱር — with poor, lacking (በ- + adjective, plural ኅሱራት, agreeing with ንዋያት)
glossary.በአጻብዒከ: ጽብዕ — with your fingers (በ- + plural አጻብዕ + -ከ '2ms your'; singular ጽብዕ from memory) (?)
glossary.በአፈ: አፍ — by the mouth of (በ- + noun, construct አፈ)
glossary.በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam')
glossary.በእንቲአሆሙ: በእንተ — on their account (preposition, form በእንቲአ- + -ሆሙ '3mp them')
glossary.በከመ: ከመ — as, in the way that (በ- 'in' + ከመ)
glossary.ቡሩክ: ቡሩክ — blessed (adjective, passive participle of ባረከ)
glossary.ባረኮ: ባረከ — he blessed him (3ms perfect, b-r-k + -ኦ 'him')
glossary.ባርከኒ: ባረከ — bless me! (2ms imperative, b-r-k, + -ኒ '1cs me')
glossary.ብሩሀ: ብሩህ — bright, shining (construct 'bright of') · accusative predicate 'bright' (ኩን ብሩሀ 'be bright')
glossary.ተሀውከ: ተሀውከ — he was troubled (3ms perfect, tä-stem)
glossary.ተሀይደ: ተሀይደ — he/it was taken away (3ms perfect passive; uncertain stem)
glossary.ተትልዎሙ: ተለወ — she follows them (3fs imperfect + -ሙ '3mp them'; the prefix ተ- for ት- is irregular, perhaps a slip) (?)
glossary.ተነሥአት: ተንሥአ — she rose (3fs perfect, n-ś-ʾ; subject ጽዮን)
glossary.ተነበየ: ተነበየ — he prophesied (3ms perfect, tä-stem of ነበየ, n-b-y)
glossary.ተንሥአ: ተንሥአ — he arose, rose up (3m sg perfect, n-s-ʾ)
glossary.ተወልዱ: ተወልደ — they were born (3mp perfect, passive/reflexive of ወለደ)
glossary.ተፋነዉ: ተፋነወ — they took leave of one another (3mp perfect, reciprocal tä-stem of ፈነወ 'send')
glossary.ቲሆሙ: ቲሆሙ — unidentified; ends in -ሆሙ '3mp their', stem unclear, perhaps corrupt (?)
glossary.ታቦተ: ታቦት — ark, tabernacle (construct 'ark of') · also accusative 'an ark' (ግበር ታቦተ 'make an ark')
glossary.ታንጠበጥብ: ነጠበ — it drips (3fs imperfect, reduplicated form of ነጠበ 'drip'; lemma inferred) (?)
glossary.ታዕካ: ታዕካ — unidentified word, perhaps a title, place or object (noun; the 'taʿka') (?)
glossary.ትሜጥዎ: መጠወ — she will hand over to him (3fs imperfect + -ዎ '3ms him'; ሜ is not the regular vowel, so ሜጠ 'turn' is a possible alternative) (?)
glossary.ትበኪ: በከየ — she weeps (3fs imperfect, after እንዘ 'while')
glossary.ትኩንከ: ኮነ — may she be to you, for you (3fs jussive, k-w-n, + -ከ '2ms you')
glossary.ኀለይከ: ኀለየ — you have thought, planned (2ms perfect, ḫ-l-y)
glossary.ኀለፈት: ኀለፈ — it passed away (3fs perfect, ḫ-l-f)
glossary.ኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, at; where (preposition / conjunction) · 'with, in the possession of' (ኢተርፈት ኀበ ኢዮርብዓም 'it did not remain with Jeroboam')
glossary.ኀጺን: ኀጺን — iron (noun; በአፈ ኀጺን 'by the edge of iron', i.e. the sword)
glossary.ኅቡረ: ኅቡር — together (accusative as adverb; from ኅብረ/ኅቡር)
glossary.ነቢረ: ነበረ — to dwell (infinitive of ነበረ 'sit, dwell') · here perhaps the accusative of the participle ነቢር 'dwelling' (ወአኮ ነቢረ 'and not a dweller') (?)
glossary.ነቢር: ነበረ — dwelling, settled (participial adjective ነቢር qualifying ሕዝብ; 'a resident or settled people') (?)
glossary.ንቱገ: ንቱግ — [ntug], defective, reproachable (?) (adjective or noun, accusative; unidentified)
glossary.ንጉሠ: ንጉሥ — king (accusative) · also construct 'king of' (ንጉሠ ሮምሂ 'the king of Rome too') · predicate accusative 'as king' (ዘይከውን ንጉሠ 'who will be king'; ይኩነነ ንጉሠ 'may he be king for us')
glossary.ንጹሐ: ንጹሕ — clean, pure, innocent (adjective; accusative form)
glossary.አልቦ: አልቦ — there is not, none (negative existential)
glossary.አመ: አመ — on, at the time of, when (preposition / conjunction)
glossary.አማዕዋቲሁ: አማዕዋት — his inward parts, bowels (plural + -ሁ '3ms his'; I do not know the singular) (?)
glossary.አሠረ: አሠር — track, footprint; አሠረ እሙ 'behind his mother' (noun, construct, used as preposition 'after')
glossary.አቤራት: አቤር — women, wives (plural አቤራት; lemma and meaning inferred from parallel with ደናግል) (?)
glossary.አኅደገቶ: አኅደገ — she/it left him, abandoned him (3fs perfect አኅደገት + -ኦ 'him')
glossary.አንብዖሙ: ዕንባ — their tears (plural አንብዕ + -ሙ '3mp their', accusative)
glossary.አውየዉ: አውየወ — they cried out, wailed (3mp perfect; related to the noun አውያት 'wailing') (?)
glossary.ኢስሕቱ: ስሕተ — they did not err (ኢ- + 3mp perfect, s-ḥ-t)
glossary.ኢኀሠሡኒ: ኀሠሠ — who did not seek me (ኢ- + 3mp perfect, ḫ-ś-ś, + -ኒ '1cs me')
glossary.ኢያአምርዎ: አእመረ — who do not know him (ኢ- + 3mp imperfect, ʾ-ʿ-m-r, + -ዎ '3ms him')
glossary.ኢያእመሩ: አእመረ — they did not know (ኢ- + 3mp perfect, ʾ-ʿ-m-r)
glossary.እሙ: እም — his mother (noun + -ሁ '3ms his', contracted እሙ)
glossary.እምነ: እም — from, out of (preposition, እምነ before a noun) · 'our mother' (እም 'mother' + -ነ 'our'): ይብልዋ ለጽዮን እምነ 'they will call Zion "our mother"'
glossary.እምኔሆሙ: እም — from them, out of them (preposition + 3mp suffix, stem እምኔ-)
glossary.እምኔየ: እም — than me (እም- + -ኔየ '1s me') · 'from me' (ትርሐቅ እምኔየ 'that you go far from me')
glossary.እምአዕይንቲሆሙ: ዐይን — from their eyes (እም- + plural አዕይንት + -ሆሙ '3mp their')
glossary.እምይእዜሰ: ይእዜ — from now on, indeed (እም- + ይእዜ 'now' + enclitic -ሰ)
glossary.እምጠለ: ጠል — from the dew of (እም- 'from' + noun, construct)
glossary.እንተ: እንተ — which, who (rel. pron. fem.) · in the phrase እንተ ባሕቲቱ 'privately, apart' (lit. 'which his solitude'; here the son is drawn aside alone) · fem. relative before a noun, ሐወጸ እንተ ታዕካ ቤተ መንግሥት 'looked out (?), which the ታዕካ of the palace'; the link to the verb is unclear (?)
glossary.እደዊሃ: እድ — her hands (plural እደው, construct-form እደዊ- + -ሃ '3fs her')
glossary.እገሪከ: እግር — your feet (noun, plural እገር + -ከ '2ms your', accusative)
glossary.ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her')
glossary.ኮነት: ኮነ — become, be (3fs perfect; subject መንግሥተ)
glossary.ኮኑ: ኮነ — they became (3mp perfect, k-w-n) · 'so they were' in a simile (ከማሁ ኮኑ 'thus they were')
glossary.ኵሉ: ኵሉ — all, every, the whole of · 'everyone', used alone (ያፈቅር ኵሉ 'everyone loves') · ወበዝ ኵሉ 'and in all this'
glossary.ኵላ: ኵሉ — all, the whole (variant form ኵላ, accusative)
glossary.ወላሐወት: ላሐወ — and (she) lamented (ወ- + 3fs perfect; verb of wailing, lemma assumed from the form) (?)
glossary.ወላሐዋ: ላሐወ — and they lamented (ወ- + 3fp perfect; subject ደናግል)
glossary.ወልጹቅ: ልጹቅ — and clinging, adhering (ወ- + adjective, from ለጽቀ)
glossary.ወሐወጸ: ሐወጸ — and he looked out (ወ- + 3ms perfect, ḥ-w-ṣ 'go about, visit') (?)
glossary.ወሕዝበ: ሕዝብ — and the people of (ወ- + noun, accusative/construct 'people of')
glossary.ወሖረ: ሖረ — and he went (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G)
glossary.ወሖሩ: ሖረ — and they went (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G, ḥ-w-r)
glossary.ወማህረክዋ: ማህረከ — and they plundered her (ወ- + 3mp perfect, quadriliteral + -ዋ '3fs her') (?)
glossary.ወርሱሓት: ርሱሕ — and filthy (ወ- + adjective, plural fem. ርሱሓት)
glossary.ወርዕደ: ርዕደ — and he trembled (ወ- + 3ms perfect, r-ʿ-d)
glossary.ወሮድዋ: ሮደ — and they attacked her (ወ- + 3mp perfect + -ዋ '3fs her'; lexical call from context) (?)
glossary.ወሰሎሞንሂ: ሰሎሞን — and Solomon too (ወ- + proper name + enclitic -ሂ)
glossary.ወሰገደ: ሰገደ — and he bowed down (ወ- + 3ms perfect, s-g-d)
glossary.ወቀተልዋ: ቀተለ — and they killed her (ወ- + 3mp perfect + -ዋ '3fs her')
glossary.ወበሣልስኒ: ሣልስ — and in the third (place) also (ወ- + በ- + ordinal 'third' + enclitic -ኒ)
glossary.ወበከመ: ከመ — and as, and according as (ወ- 'and' + በ- + ከመ)
glossary.ወበከያ: በከየ — and they wept (ወ- + 3fp perfect, b-k-y; subject አቤራት)
glossary.ወበካልእኒ: ካልእ — and in another (place) also (ወ- + በ- + ካልእ 'other' + enclitic -ኒ)
glossary.ወባረኮ: ባረከ — and he blessed him (ወ- + 3ms perfect + -ኦ 'him')
glossary.ወቦአ: ቦአ — and he entered (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, b-w-ʾ)
glossary.ወተሀውከ: ተሀውከ — and he was troubled (ወ- + 3ms perfect, tä-stem)
glossary.ወተሀይደት: ተሀይደ — and it was carried off (ወ- + 3fs perfect; uncertain stem, see ተሀይደ)
glossary.ወተባረከ: ባረከ — and he was blessed (ወ- + 3ms perfect, passive-reflexive ተ- stem of ባረከ, b-r-k)
glossary.ወተነፍሐ: ተነፍሐ — and was blown (ወ- + 3ms perfect passive, tä-stem of ነፍሐ, n-f-ḥ)
glossary.ወተንሡ: ተንሥአ — and they rose (ወ- + 3mp perfect, n-ś-ʾ)
glossary.ወተጽዕኑ: ተጽዕነ — and they were loaded (ወ- + 3mp perfect, passive tä-stem of ጽዕነ, ṣ-ʿ-n)
glossary.ወተፋነዉ: ተፋነወ — and they took leave of one another (ወ- + 3mp perfect)
glossary.ወትኩን: ኮነ — and let it be, may it be (ወ- + 3fs jussive)
glossary.ወነሠተ: ነሠተ — and he took away, removed (ወ- + 3ms perfect) (?)
glossary.ወነገሥተ: ንጉሥ — and kings of (ወ- + plural ነገሥት, construct)
glossary.ወአልቦ: አልቦ — and there is not (ወ- 'and' + negative existential)
glossary.ወአራዊተ: አርዌ — and beasts (ወ- + plural አራዊት, accusative/construct 'beasts of')
glossary.ወአቅደሙ: አቀደመ — and they did beforehand, first (ወ- + 3mp perfect, causative of ቀደመ, q-d-m)
glossary.ወአቡየኒ: አብ — and my father also (ወ- + noun + -የ '1cs my' + enclitic -ኒ)
glossary.ወአብዝኀ: አብዝኀ — and he multiplied (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative of ብዝኀ 'be many', b-z-ḫ)
glossary.ወአኀዞ: አኀዘ — and he took hold of him (ወ- + 3ms perfect, ʾ-ḫ-z, + -ኦ 'him')
glossary.ወአንሥኦ: አንሥአ — and he raised him (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative, n-ś-ʾ + -ኦ 'him'; subject not stated) · or here perhaps ወ- + infinitive አንሥኦ 'and to lift up', before ኵናቶ (?)
glossary.ወአንብዑ: ዕንባ — and his tears (ወ- + plural አንብዕ + -ሁ '3ms his', nominative)
glossary.ወአንጸርከ: አንጸረ — and you have looked toward, regarded (ወ- + 2ms perfect, ʾ-n-ṣ-r; 'pointed' in the translation is a guess from 'with the fingers') (?)
glossary.ወአእምሮ: አእምሮ — and knowledge (ወ- + verbal noun of አእመረ)
glossary.ወአእዱግኒ: አድግ — and donkeys also (ወ- + plural አእዱግ + enclitic -ኒ)
glossary.ወአዕዋፈ: ዖፍ — and birds (ወ- + plural አዕዋፍ, accusative)
glossary.ወእምስፍሓ: ስፍሕ — and from the breadth of (ወ- + እም- + noun 'breadth'; the final -ሓ is probably the pronoun suffix -ሃ 'it', doubled by ለምድር) (?)
glossary.ወእምይእዜሰ: ይእዜ — and from now on, indeed (ወ- + እም- + ይእዜ 'now' + enclitic -ሰ)
glossary.ወከለላ: ከለለ — and (it) covered her (ወ- + 3ms perfect ከለለ + -ሃ 'her', the city: ከለለ+ሃ → ከለላ) (?)
glossary.ወከልሑ: ከልሐ — and they shouted (ወ- + 3mp perfect, k-l-ḥ)
glossary.ወከመ: ከመ — that, so that (conjunction; ወ- 'and') · and as (ወከመ ዝ 'and as this')
glossary.ወክሡት: ክሡት — and revealed, uncovered (ወ- + adjective, from ከሠተ)
glossary.ወኵሎሙ: ኵሉ — and all of them, and all (ወ- + ኵሉ + -ሙ '3mp')
glossary.ወወውዑ: ውዕየ — and they burned (ወ- + 3mp perfect, w-ʿ-y; vocalization of the form irregular) (?)
glossary.ወወድቀት: ወድቀ — and it fell (ወ- + 3fs perfect, w-d-q)
glossary.ወውእቱኒ: ውእቱ — and he also (ወ- + pronoun + enclitic -ኒ)
glossary.ወውዕየት: ውዕየ — and it burned (ወ- + 3fs perfect, w-ʿ-y)
glossary.ወዓሣተ: ዓሣ — and fish (ወ- + plural ዓሣት, accusative/construct 'fish of')
glossary.ወዖዳ: ዖደ — and (it) encircled her (ወ- + 3ms perfect ዖደ + -ሃ 'her': ዖደ+ሃ → ዖዳ) (?)
glossary.ወዘልዑልለከ: ልዑል — and that which is high, for you (ወ- + ዘ- + adjective + ለከ 'for you', written as one word)
glossary.ወዘቅሩብ: ቅሩብ — and that which is near (ወ- + ዘ- + adjective)
glossary.ወዘባረኮ: ባረከ — and who blessed him (ወ- + ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect + -ኦ 'him')
glossary.ወዘኢያስተርኢ: አስተርአየ — and that which does not appear (ወ- + ዘ- + ኢ- + 3ms imperfect)
glossary.ወዘውስጥ: ውስጥ — and that which is within (ወ- + ዘ- + noun/adverb 'inside')
glossary.ወዘድኩም: ድኩም — and that which is weak (ወ- + ዘ- + adjective)
glossary.ወዘገዳም: ገዳም — and that of the wilderness (ወ- + ዘ- + noun)
glossary.ወያስሕዙ: አውሐዘ — and they let flow (ወ- + 3mp imperfect; apparently a metathesised spelling of ያውሕዙ) (?)
glossary.ወይበክዩ: በከየ — and they wept (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, b-k-y)
glossary.ወይባርክ: ባረከ — and he will bless (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, b-r-k)
glossary.ወይቤሎ: ብህለ — and he said to him (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎ 'to him')
glossary.ወይብልዋ: ብህለ — and they will say to her, call her (ወ- + 3mp imperfect + -ዋ '3fs her', b-h-l)
glossary.ወይተሉ: ተለወ — and he follows (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, t-l-w)
glossary.ወይትአዘዝ: ተአዘዘ — and let it be subject, obey (ወ- + 3ms jussive, tä-stem of አዘዘ 'command', ʾ-z-z)
glossary.ወይወድዩ: ወደየ — and they put, place (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, w-d-y)
glossary.ወይግረሩ: ገረረ — and may they bow down, yield (ወ- + 3mp jussive; root and meaning inferred from context) (?)
glossary.ወይፍርሁከ: ፈርሀ — and may they fear you (ወ- + 3mp jussive, f-r-ḥ, + -ከ '2ms you')
glossary.ወደምፀት: ደምፀ — and it sounded, resounded (ወ- + 3fs perfect, d-m-ṣ; subject ሀገር) (?)
glossary.ወደንገፀ: ደንገፀ — and he was dismayed, startled (ወ- + 3ms perfect, d-n-g-ṣ)
glossary.ወግዕዙ: ግዕዘ — and they departed (ወ- + 3mp perfect, g-ʿ-z)
glossary.ወጐየት: ጐየ — and she fled (ወ- + 3fs perfect, g-w-y)
glossary.ወጸላእቱሂ: ጸላኢ — and his enemies too (ወ- + plural ጸላእት + -ሁ '3ms his' + enclitic -ሂ)
glossary.ወጽራኀ: ጽራኅ — and the cry of (ወ- + noun, construct)
glossary.ወፄወውዋ: ፄወወ — and they took her captive (ወ- + 3mp perfect + -ዋ '3fs her')
glossary.ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors')
glossary.ዐማፄ: ዐማፂ — unjust one, wrongdoer (noun/participle of ዐመፀ; accusative)
glossary.ዘ: ዘ — who, which, whom (relative pronoun, written apart from the verb: ሕፃን ዘ አኅደገቶ 'a child whom ... left him')
glossary.ዘርሑቅ: ርሑቅ — far, distant (adjective; ዘ- 'that which is')
glossary.ዘባረኮ: ባረከ — who blessed him (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect + -ኦ 'him')
glossary.ዘቤተ: ቤት — of the house of (ዘ- 'of, that of' + ቤተ, construct 'house of')
glossary.ዘቤት: ቤት — that of the house, domestic (ዘ- + noun)
glossary.ዘተንሥኡ: ተንሥአ — who rose (ዘ- relative + 3mp perfect, n-ś-ʾ)
glossary.ዘተወልደ: ተወልደ — who was born (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, passive/reflexive stem of ወለደ)
glossary.ዘትሑት: ትሑት — low, humble (adjective; ዘ- 'that which is')
glossary.ዘትበኪ: በከየ — that weeps (ዘ- relative + 3fs imperfect, b-k-y)
glossary.ዘኅቡእ: ኅቡእ — hidden (adjective, passive participle of ኀብአ; ዘ- 'that which is')
glossary.ዘአፍአ: አፍአ — that which is outside (ዘ- + adverb/noun 'outside')
glossary.ዘእቱት: እቱት — loose, detached (adjective; ዘ- 'that which is'; paired with ልጹቅ) (?)
glossary.ዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — without, except (preposition) · conjunction 'without' + jussive (ዘእንበለ ይስቅይዋ 'without their watering her') · conjunction + perfect 'without (its having been done)' (ዘእንበለ ተሀበኒ ትእምርተ 'without a sign having been given me') · 'except' (ዘእንበለ ዘተሐምም 'except what she suffered')
glossary.ዘክቡት: ክቡት — closed, shut (adjective, from ከበተ; ዘ- 'that which is') (?)
glossary.ዘዐገትዋ: ዐገተ — as (when) they besieged her (ዘ- + 3mp perfect, ʿ-g-t, + -ዋ '3fs her')
glossary.ዝንቱኑ: ዝንቱ — this one indeed? (demonstrative + interrogative enclitic -ኑ)
glossary.የሀሉ: ሀሎ — let him be, may he be (3ms jussive)
glossary.ያውሕዙ: አውሐዘ — they cause to flow, shed (3mp imperfect, causative of ወሐዘ 'flow', w-ḥ-z)
glossary.ይሖር: ሖረ — that he might go (3ms jussive/subjunctive after ከመ, ḥ-w-r)
glossary.ይሴብሕዎ: ሴበሐ — they will praise him (3mp imperfect, s-b-ḥ, + -ዎ '3ms him')
glossary.ይቀምሑ: ቀምሐ — they will taste (3mp imperfect, q-m-ḥ; 'lick' would fit the psalm) (?)
glossary.ይብል: ብህለ — he says (3ms imperfect, G stem, defective verb b-h-l)
glossary.ይትሜጠዋ: ተመጠወ — he will receive her (3ms imperfect, tä-stem, + -ዋ '3fs her'; spelled ሜ for መ) (?)
glossary.ይትወሀቦሙ: ተውህበ — it will be given to them (3ms imperfect passive of ወሀበ, + -ሙ '3mp to them')
glossary.ይእቲ: ይእቲ — she/it is (fem. pron.) · 'I am she' predicate (አነ ይእቲ አቡከ 'I am she, your father')
glossary.ይኩን: ኮነ — let him be (3m sg jussive, k-w-n)
glossary.ይገንዩ: ገነየ — they will bow, serve (3mp imperfect, g-n-y)
glossary.ይጸሊ: ጸለየ — that he might pray (3ms jussive/subjunctive, ṣ-l-y)
glossary.ይጸርኅ: ጸርሐ — he cries out (3ms imperfect, ṣ-r-ḥ)
glossary.ደቂቀ: ደቂቅ — sons, children (plural ደቂቅ, construct 'sons of')
glossary.ዳዊት: ዳዊት — David (proper name) · 'ዳዊት' also in ማኅፈደ ዳዊት 'tower (?) of David' (genitive after a construct) · also the young prince Menelik, styled David (እግዚእክሙ ዳዊት 'your lord David')
glossary.ገሃደ: ገሃድ — openly, evident (adjective as adverbial accusative)
glossary.ጥበ: ጥብ — breast (?) (noun, construct 'breast of'; sense inferred from the simile of mother and child) (?)
glossary.ጽዒኖታ: ጽዒኖት — loading (verbal noun of ጽዕነ 'load', + -ሃ '3fs her': 'the loading of her') (?)
glossary.ፀር: ፀር — enemy (noun; genitive after the construct አህጉረ, 'of the enemy') · nominative, collective 'an enemy' (ወይበልዕ ፀር እለ ኢታአምር 'an enemy you do not know will eat')
glossary.ፀዋገ: ፀዋግ — captor, one who takes captive (noun; accusative; lexical call from context) (?)
glossary.ፍጹመ: ፍጹም — perfectly, completely (adjective as adverbial accusative) · predicate accusative 'perfect' (ኩን ፍጹመ 'be perfect')
